mathematics.assertion_tested: Five Lean lemmas: completed characteristic square, negative quarter-discriminant excludes real roots, wrong-sign isotropic form is positive on nonzero covectors, negative asymptotic limit implies an eventually negative tail, and no everywhere-real characteristic cone can approach that tail.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Real numbers and real-valued radial functions, exact arithmetic
mathematics.conventions: Characteristic K*c^2+B*c-G; quarter=B^2/4+K*G. Approaches is the explicit epsilon/radius definition, not a finite sample assertion. spatialNormSq represents squared spatial covector norm.

bounds.domain: negative limiting quarter-discriminant; explicit radial convergence; isotropic-form lemma additionally K>0,G<0

non_claims: No formalized action variation, PDE existence or global well-posedness theorem
No certification of numerical exterior coefficients or of a recombination history
No assumption that scalar-gradient decay alone implies full principal-jet convergence
No exclusion of all other cosmological asymptotics or action architectures
